params.1273: Plant some potato seeds so they grow into potatoes.
params.1274: <col=FFFFFF>Trade</col> with <col=FFFFFF>Head Farmer Jones</col> and get <col=FFFFFF>3 potato seeds</col>.
params.1275: <col=FFFFFF>Click</col> on the <col=FFFFFF>farming patch</col> to clear the weeds.
params.1276: Once the patch is clear, <col=FFFFFF>left-click</col> the <col=FFFFFF>seeds</col> in your inventory and click on the patch to plant them.
params.2225:
Come back later on to harvest your potatoes. Weeding, planting and harvesting all give Farming XP.

You can put the weeds you got in the compost bin by using them on it from your inventory.
